description: Validates scenario-experience-spec/v1 contracts and experience maturity through experience-manager.

capabilities.label: Spec Contract
capabilities.description: Experience index, page, journey, route, reference, binding, and tier rules are parseable and internally consistent.

levels.name: Contract parseable
levels.description: The contract parses, but schema or index parity findings remain.
levels.capability_summary: Experience intent exists but is not structurally trustworthy.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve schema and index parity findings.

levels.name: References linked
levels.description: Documents parse and cross-file references, PRD refs, bindings, and tier semantics are clean.
levels.capability_summary: The experience contract is internally linked.
levels.next_unlock: Ground active pages in structure evidence.

levels.name: Contract clean
levels.capability_summary: Experience intent is a trustworthy machine-checkable contract.

capabilities.label: Structure Reconciliation
capabilities.description: Machine-tier claims are reconciled against captured accessibility structure with honest skip semantics.

levels.name: Capture unavailable
levels.description: No usable BAS accessibility capture is available.
levels.capability_summary: Machine-tier experience claims cannot be checked against UI structure.
levels.next_unlock: Capture the target page accessibility tree.

levels.name: Bindings joinable
levels.description: Bindings can be compared with captured structure, but unresolved bindings or uncheckable claims remain.
levels.capability_summary: The spec can start grounding in the live UI.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve binding and checker coverage gaps.

levels.name: Claims checked
levels.description: Tier 0-1 machine claims are evaluated against captured structure.
levels.capability_summary: Active machine-tier claims have deterministic evidence.

levels.name: Structure clean
levels.description: Structure reconciliation findings are clean for active pages.
levels.capability_summary: The built UI structure satisfies the machine-tier experience spec.

capabilities.label: Manual Evidence
capabilities.description: Manual-tier claims carry explicit attestations with freshness semantics.

levels.name: No attestation evidence
levels.description: Manual-tier claims have no usable attestation evidence.
levels.next_unlock: Record an attestation with author, rationale, and expiry.

levels.name: Attestations present
levels.description: Manual attestations exist but expired or stale evidence remains.
levels.capability_summary: Manual claims have reviewable evidence with freshness debt.

levels.name: Attestations fresh
levels.capability_summary: Manual experience claims are honestly current.

capabilities.label: Perception Advisory
capabilities.description: Deferred perception-tier checks remain advisory until calibrated.

levels.name: Perception unevaluated
levels.description: Perception-tier checks are not part of v1 gating.
levels.capability_summary: Visual saliency and glance judgment are visible only as future seams.
levels.next_unlock: Calibrate deterministic perception checks in the P2 tier.

levels.name: Advisory perception visible
levels.description: Perception findings are reported as non-gating advisory evidence.
levels.capability_summary: Experience-manager can show perception debt without failing suites.

experience.schema_invalid.reason: Schema repair needs source-level contract edits.

experience.index_parity.reason: Index parity repair needs source-level contract edits.

experience.ref_unresolved.reason: Choosing the correct referenced page, state, or element requires author intent.

experience.prd_ref_unmatched.reason: Choosing the correct operational target is an intent decision.

experience.binding_orphan.reason: Binding repair depends on the intended UI element contract.

experience.tier_violation.reason: Tier changes alter enforcement intent and need author judgment.

experience.route_unspecced.reason: Route coverage decisions require product intent.

experience.state_missing.reason: State coverage decisions require design intent.

experience.binding_unresolved.reason: Resolving live binding drift depends on the intended selector or markup.

experience.claim_failed.reason: A failed experience claim may require product, design, or implementation changes.

experience.claim_unverifiable.reason: Checker coverage gaps require choosing a supported claim type or adding validator capability.

experience.capture_unavailable.reason: Capture availability is an operational condition, not an in-place source fix.

experience.attestation_expired.reason: Refreshing manual evidence requires a human attestation.

experience.claim_unproven.reason: Evidence must be captured or the claim should be retiered deliberately.

experience.importance_mismatch.reason: Perception calibration is deferred to the P2 tier.

experience.glance_judge_mismatch.reason: Judge-based perception is deferred and non-gating.
